title: Indonesia's vice president Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigns after court dispute
caption:
Indonesia's vice president Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the son of former president Joko Widodo, has resigned after courts ruled against the school documents he used to run for office and about 120 lawmakers moved to impeach him. President Prabowo Subianto accepted the resignation. Parliament now has up to 60 days to choose a successor from two candidates nominated by the president.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
